comment: Drop-zone manifest — where each kind of asset lands. Targets are relative to projects/{slug}/. 'named: true' means files go into a per-name subfolder (e.g. characters/{name}/).

zones.label: Source Material
zones.hint: Interview video / audio / transcript / photos. Inputs only, forever.

zones.label: Character Sheets
zones.hint: Turnarounds + signature details, one folder per character.

zones.label: Environments
zones.hint: Location refs — the world by location, per set.

zones.label: Style Refs
zones.hint: Ink-and-watercolour anchors feeding the style block.

zones.label: Timing / Shot List
zones.hint: Storyboard Pro FCP XML (one clip per panel), shot list xlsx.
